title: get_api_v1_public_projects_slug_notfound
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/public/projects/:slug returns 404 with a handled not-found response when the project slug does not exist.

title: post_api_v1_auth_login_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials returns 200 with Access Token and Refresh Token.

title: post_api_v1_auth_login_invalid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401 with a generic authentication error without disclosing user existence.

title: post_api_v1_auth_refresh_valid_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with a valid Refresh Token returns 200 with a new Access Token.

title: post_api_v1_auth_refresh_invalid_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with expired or malformed token returns 401 with an authentication error response.

title: post_api_v1_auth_logout_valid_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/logout with a valid Refresh Token returns 204 or 200 confirming logout and invalidates the token for further refresh attempts.

title: post_api_v1_admin_posts_create_duplicate_slug
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/admin/posts with a duplicate slug returns 409 conflict or validation error indicating the slug is already in use.

title: post_api_v1_contact_valid_submission
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/contact with valid name, email, message, and captcha token returns 201 or 200 confirming submission, persists the message, and sends notification email.

title: post_api_v1_contact_missing_captcha
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/contact with missing or invalid captcha token returns 400 or 403 with captcha validation failure.

title: get_api_v1_health_check
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/health returns 200 with healthy status and service metadata.
